variants.name: Type=Desktop, State=Expanded
texts: One of the biggest challenges with DCM is that it’s highly heterogeneous, both in its presentation and its underlying aetiology. While environmental factors, such as infections or exposure to certain toxins, are linked with DCM, genetics also play a role: up to 35% of DCM cases have an identifiable genetic cause.
